rule_family: six fixed method-priority permutations with identical eligibility gates
objective: maximize dev mean joint AUC@10, using stage3 empirical-CDF integral and zero for unavailable pairs
tie_break: lexicographic canonical order; cannot learn fallback order when raw always wins
eligibility: full successful camera output plus at least one available geometric evidence pair; partial evidence allowed with explicit warning
no_eligible_candidate: abstain; no fabricated cameras or per-view mixing
selection_mode: eager snapshots; account for all baseline branches and shared diagnostics
